# Copilot Repository Instructions

Canonical repository instructions live in `AGENTS.md`.

- Follow the nearest applicable `AGENTS.md` file for the path being edited.
- Use this file only as a pointer; do not treat it as a second source of truth.
- If a root and child `AGENTS.md` both apply, use the child file for subtree-specific rules and the root file for everything else.
- Do not duplicate full repository guidance here; update `AGENTS.md` instead.
